shadows.name: contact-hover-glow

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Source --ease-out for press, topic height/icon, mobile menu and one-time reveals.

motion.name: contact-state
motion.value: background-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 220ms ease, transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)
motion.purpose: Contact fill, glow and scale(0.97) press.

motion.name: card-state
motion.purpose: Approach card hover border; topic cards also declare background-color 200ms ease.

motion.name: topic-icon
motion.purpose: Vertical plus stroke disappears into the minus.

motion.name: mobile-menu
motion.purpose: Hidden/visible phone navigation; menu strokes separately use 220ms ease-out.

motion.name: section-reveal
motion.purpose: One time at IntersectionObserver threshold 0.08: opacity 0.65→1 and translateY(14px)→0; content starts visible.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto
motion.purpose: CSS covers every element and pseudo-element. JavaScript skips observation initially; a switch to reduced motion disconnects observation and finishes active Web Animations.

narrative.overview:
The supplied reference establishes a near-black blue field, an unchanged portrait, large white Montserrat and fine static neon ribbons. “Portrait and neon ribbons” names those existing elements; it is a description of the implemented reference, not a new creative direction.

Tiffany capsules carry contact actions, while blue, red and cyan distinguish the translucent card treatments. Borders, low-opacity gradients and clipped vector curves give the page depth. The composition is dense enough to preserve the compact reference while retaining generous introductory type.
keyCharacteristics: Locally served Montserrat with strong Cyrillic headlines and closely tracked titles.
Near-black blue surfaces, white text and Tiffany contact capsules.
Thin colored borders and static blue, red and cyan SVG ribbons.
An unchanged supplied portrait with CSS edge masks.
Asymmetric approach cards, compact topic cards and explicit keyboard states.

rules.name: Static Artwork
rules.body: Portrait, ribbons and ambient gradients remain still; motion is limited to interface state and one-time section reveals.

rules.name: Focus Parity
rules.body: Keep visible focus on every keyboard control; topic focus stays inset inside its clipped card.

dos: Do use the supplied portrait unchanged and blend its edges with CSS masks.
Do retain Montserrat, the established weight hierarchy and the close title tracking.
Do use the Tiffany capsule for contact actions and the blue/red/cyan surface treatments for cards.
Do preserve the 18px card radius and compact 3/3/2 topic arrangement above the tablet breakpoint.
Do let a topic expand inside its card while closing any previously open topic.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and the complete reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't replace the real portrait with an AI-generated person.
Don't animate the portrait, ribbons or background gradients.
Don't turn the outlined “О себе” label into an interactive filter.
Don't apply hover-only effects to touch devices.
Don't add new visual variants, colors or typefaces without updating the source system.
Don't hide content until a reveal animation runs.
